title: Vegetable Gardening and Grain Stacking (Historical)
publisher: F. F. Rockwell (1911); J. N. DeLamater (1884)
license: Public domain — published in the United States before 1929
attribution: Text from F. F. Rockwell, Home Vegetable Gardening (1911), chapters VI-XI and XIV, and J. N. DeLamater, A Revised and Illustrated Treatise on Grain Stacking (Norwalk, Ohio, 1884), from Project Gutenberg transcriptions (PG license text stripped). Reformatted into sections without changing substance; figures not included; a passage recommending obsolete insecticides is not included.
description: Manures and fertilizers, preparing soil, starting plants, sowing, cultivating, the needs of each common vegetable (potatoes, beans, corn, squash and more), harvesting and winter storage; stacking bound grain so it keeps until threshing. Over 100 years old: varieties, fertilizers and practices are outdated.
